paired.risk_difference_ci_method: Difference of 97.5% Clopper-Pearson intervals for win/loss probabilities; Bonferroni simultaneous >=95%, conservative.
paired.mcnemar_method: Two-sided exact binomial test conditional on discordant pairs, capped at1; primary one registered contrast.

final_xy_paired_delta_cm.interpretation: Negative favors masks. Includes unsuccessful completed episodes; secondary descriptive endpoint.

episode_steps_paired_delta.interpretation: masks minus point executed steps at termination; secondary descriptive endpoint, success ends early.

point_cue_pixels_inside_masks.interpretation: Role-mask pixels changed by the frozen point-arm bbox/crosshair cue; descriptive only, never a fidelity requirement.

inside_mask_pixels_changed.requirement: zero wherever reported (gate G5, masks arm only)

fidelity.reading_rule: Leaves are dicts with mask_px and/or ring_px inside the event payload; camera and role come from their camera/role fields or enclosing mapping keys; operation from payload operation, stage_operation or stage.operation (else no_active_stage). A leaf counts as drawn when its own drawn flag (else ring_px>0) and the event drawn flag (else arm==treatment) hold. Masks arm: inside_mask_pixels_changed is collected at any depth. Point arm: point_cue_pixels_inside_masks is collected at any depth, else the older point-arm name inside_mask_pixels_changed; source_fields counts which name each event used.
fidelity.interpretation: Coverage counts steps per operation and camera on which any outline of that camera was drawn. Gate G5 applies to the masks (treatment) arm only: inside_mask_pixels_changed is 0 wherever reported. The point-arm count of mask pixels covered by the frozen point cue is descriptive and has no requirement. These numbers never alter outcomes, pair eligibility or the registered contrast.

limits: Success time is conditioned on success; it is not a standalone efficiency comparison.
Failures retain terminal elapsed time and control steps, but have null success completion time.
Whole-run elapsed_seconds is never relabeled or substituted for missing task_time_v1.
Hardware, model service placement, and concurrency form an execution cohort; no cross-cohort speedup is claimed.
Only the fixed 12 new seed pairs enter this denominator; historical development results are never pooled.
600-action horizon exhaustion is a known task failure; infrastructure/wall-clock timeout remains unknown.
Missing/invalid/partial traces cannot become task failures or successes; excluded pair counts remain visible.
Paired rates/CI use the same eligible seed subset; if pairs are missing, no complete 24-case claim is justified.
Final XY is at each episode termination (success earlier than 600); it is not a common-time 600 trajectory comparison.
Distances include known failures and are relative to naturally selected and bound regions; geometry thresholds are never control inputs.
Wilson intervals are approximate; paired effect interval is conservative. 12 seed pairs have limited power, and a nonsignificant result is not equivalence.
One task, one model, one fixed implementation; no cross-model/benchmark or real-world generalization claim.
Masks are oracle simulator segmentation and a geometric destination proxy: an upper-bound presentation cue, not perception.
Mask-presentation fidelity is descriptive only; it never conditions outcomes, pair eligibility or the registered contrast.
Complete archive array-hash and GPU/renderer identity audits remain separate mandatory evidence checks.
